svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 7.9 m; tape, cut and heat seal both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top loop: figure-eight on a bight with a 60 tail, loop

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 80 long (fits the 10 mm screw link).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From the loop's knot measure 1,106 down: mark rung 1.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Then mark every 335 for rungs 2 to 13 (12 more marks).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark both ropes side by side so the marks match.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: At each mark: overhand stopper knot, its top at the mark,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tied when the rung is threaded (build step 11).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Below rung 13: 280 to a figure-eight loop for the bottom link.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dress and set every knot by hand before loading.
